scopeNote: Search-query-language evidence for ES, PT and EN terms relevant to the nine MAREA families. No absolute volume is recorded anywhere: Google Trends was INACCESSIBLE and no accessible source supplied keyword volumes.

accessibilitySummary.googleTrends: INACCESSIBLE — https://trends.google.com/trends/explore?q=receptor%20AIS&geo=ES returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-31; the Trends root page loads only a JavaScript shell with no retrievable series. No relative-interest index is recorded.
accessibilitySummary.bingAutosuggest: ACCESSIBLE — https://api.bing.com/osjson.aspx returned live suggestion lists for market es-ES, pt-PT and en-GB on 2026-10-31. Used as query-language evidence only.
accessibilitySummary.keywordVolumeTools: NOT USED — no paid data, no third-party volume service and no estimated volume was available; therefore zero ESTIMATED_VOLUME records exist by design.

terms.observedValue: Returned as an autosuggest completion of the prefix 'monitorizar barco'.
terms.limitation: Suggestion presence only; suggests the noun form 'monitoreo' is the natural Spanish phrasing rather than 'monitorizar'. No volume.

terms.observedValue: Returned as an autosuggest completion of the prefix 'monitorizar barco'.

terms.observedValue: Completions were dominated by the display manufacturer 'Barco' ('what is a barco monitor', 'download barco monitor drivers', 'barco monitor power button'); marine phrasings appeared only as 'monitoreo de barcos en tiempo real' and 'posicionamiento de barcos en directo'.
terms.limitation: Direct evidence of a brand-collision naming risk in Spanish; this is a keyword-strategy finding, not a demand measurement.

terms.observedValue: Completions included 'piloto automatico barco segunda mano' plus aviation and motorcycle pollution ('piloto privado de avion', 'piloto automatico para moto').
terms.limitation: Suggestion presence only; a second-hand completion indicates a used-market price anchor that a premium new pilot product competes against. No volume.

terms.observedValue: Returned as an autosuggest completion of 'piloto automatico velero'.
terms.limitation: Suggestion presence only; used-equipment demand signal, not first-purchase demand for MAREA PILOT.

terms.observedValue: Completions were unrelated senses: 'receptor assay', 'receptor airplay', 'receptor ads-b', 'receptor risk assessment'.
terms.limitation: Suggestion presence only; the Portuguese prefix is dominated by biological/laboratory 'receptor' and Apple AirPlay. The correct PT search vocabulary was not observed and is a hypothesis for MC-10.

terms.observedValue: Completions were dominated by 'monitorização barragens' (dams), 'barco monitor' (display brand), 'site de monitoramento de navios' and Spanish 'control de embarques y monitoreo'.
terms.limitation: Suggestion presence only; no clean Portuguese boat-monitoring phrasing appeared. Content strategy for PT must be tested, not assumed.

terms.observedValue: Completions included 'piloto automático o que é' (definitional), 'carteira de piloto de barco' / 'licença para pilotar barco' (boat-driving licence intent), and Spanish 'piloto automatico barco segunda mano'.
terms.limitation: Suggestion presence only; Portuguese 'piloto' collides with skipper-licence intent, so a naive translation of the Spanish strategy would target the wrong user.
